source_locator: R2227: Appendix C; R2232: ch. 3, The Thirteenth Air Force (pp. 80, 87)
current_activity: forward echelon arriving in the Guadalcanal area
notes: USMC Operations vol. I, Appendix C, dates the 2nd Marine Aircraft Wing, Forward Echelon, in the Guadalcanal area from 26 December 1942, Brigadier General Francis P. Mulcahy commanding. Craven and Cate, vol. IV, ch. 3, pp. 80 and 87, independently record that Mulcahy came up with that forward echelon on 26 December and, on the same day, assumed the Senior Naval Aviator role on Guadalcanal, with operational control of the wing and of the other aircraft on the island. Confidence is raised from 0.5 to 0.7 because the USMC official family and the USAAF official family now agree on the unit, the date and the island base. (An earlier note had treated Craven ch. 3 n. 122 as evidence only of a Mulcahy/Woods command change, with the place taken from the appendix; the chapter body, not only that footnote, places the wing on Guadalcanal on 26 December.)
